limitations: Observed cases only, not full XML/name/native parity. XML replay differences are retained as observed.
System-library identities are captured receipts; only packaged prefix libraries and fonts physically rehashed.
Native warnings/failures preserved verbatim, including timestamps/PIDs/pointers if present.
No native external-link prohibition instrumented; product resolver counters are separate evidence.

qualification.defaults: Every data sheet contains Sheet_Title=quoted display name and Print_Area=#REF!, both positioned at A1.
qualification.globalShadowing: The globals input matches product output exactly, including qualified default names, explicit global names, exact lowercase name, INDIRECT and SUM.
openDifferences: Undefined explicitly global Sheet_Title/Print_Area: native recovers constant strings and warnings; product creates #NAME? placeholders.
Qualified local Print_Area=$B$1 evaluates on caller Here (9) natively, but product evaluates on definition Data (17).
qualification.escapedFixture: Original single-backslash qualified spelling is invalid under native sheet-name escaping. Raw native warnings and recovered string formulas are retained; it is not a positive qualified-name control. Positive double-backslash spelling and literal title escaping are separately unit tested.
